Compose: `collectAsState`, sealed-state `when`, clickable Cards. Tests: MockK, `runTest`, `coEvery`, `toList`, assertions. Gradle: Kotlin JVM/serialization, Ktor plugin, `jvmToolchain`, Ktor/coroutines/Exposed/PostgreSQL and test dependencies.
